caption_used: Negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant tokens between baseline MistralV0.2-Base and the same model further fine-tuned on each specialty data. The chart displays six specialty groups along the x-axis (Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, Pediatrics), with the y-axis showing negative log probability ranging from approximately -27 to -22. Within each group, the MistralV0.2-Base bar (light blue) consistently shows the highest negative log probability, indicating weaker token predictions at baseline. Among the fine-tuned models, the Gastro-tuned variant achieves the lowest negative log probability across most specialty groups, suggesting strong cross-specialty transfer. Notably, the Infect group shows the largest overall bar heights, with baseline reaching approximately -23.5, while the Cardio group exhibits the smallest spread between baseline and fine-tuned variants at roughly 1.5 units.
raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The bar chart compares the negative log probability of clinically relevant tokens for the MistralV0.2-Base model and its variants fine-tuned on six medical specialties: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The x-axis represents the specialty groups, arranged in order from left to right, while the y-axis displays the negative log probability, ranging from approximately -27 to -22, with values decreasing downward. For each specialty group, two bars are shown: the MistralV0.2-Base model (light blue) and the model fine-tuned on that specialty (color-coded according to the legend). The MistralV0.2-Base bar is consistently the tallest (highest negative log probability) in each group, indicating weaker token predictions compared to the fine-tuned variants. The fine-tuned bars are shorter, with the Gastro-tuned variant generally showing the lowest negative log probability across most specialty groups. The bars within each group are grouped side-by-side, with the baseline model on the left and the fine-tuned model on the right. The Cardio group exhibits the smallest difference between baseline and fine-tuned bars, while the Infect group shows the largest overall bar heights, with the baseline reaching approximately -23.5.
